[[General/Legends|General]] '''Gav Vannar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the ''Right Fist'' of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Hadiya]] during the [[Despot War]]. After the defeat of the [[Despot Army]] at the [[Battle of Tython]], Vannar was banished from his homeworld of [[Shikaakwa]] and [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|exiled]] on [[Nox (planet)|Nox]] with the others Generals of Hadiya's Inner Circle.
